errors.text_span: Оста X е обозначена като година
errors.evidence: The X-axis is not labeled. The description hallucinates the label 'година' (year).

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като „Средногодишен темп на инфлация“
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. The description hallucinates a label, likely taking it from the figure's caption, which is not part of the axis itself.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при стойност 2,50% в началото на 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The line starts at approximately 2.30% for the year 2012, not 2.50%.

errors.text_span: намалява до 0,50% в края на 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The line decreases to 0.00% in the year 2013, not 0.50% at the end of 2012.

errors.text_span: след което се покачва до 1,00% в края на 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The value for 2014 is approximately 0.7%, not 1.00%. The description also misattributes this point to the end of 2013.

errors.text_span: линията слиза до 0,15% в края на 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The value for 2015 is approximately 0.2%, not 0.15%. The description also misattributes this point to the end of 2014.

errors.text_span: след което се покачва до 0,40% в края на 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The line decreases from 2015 (~0.2%) to 2016 (~0.1%); it does not increase ('покачва'). The value for 2016 is approximately 0.1%, not 0.40%.

errors.text_span: спада до 0,10% в края на 2016 г., след което се покачва до 2,80% в края на 2017 г.
errors.evidence: This sequence is incorrect. The value in 2016 is ~0.1%, but it then sharply increases to a peak of ~2.9% in 2017. The description claims it increases to 2.80% at the 'end of 2017', which seems to be a misreading of the 2018 value (~2.6%).

errors.text_span: Наблюдава се спад до 2,30% в края на 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The line shows an increase from 2018 (~2.6%) to 2019 (~2.7%), not a decrease ('спад'). The value reported (2.30%) is also incorrect.

errors.text_span: и след това линията достига 2,20% в края на 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The chart data ends at the year 2019. There is no subsequent data point, so this value is hallucinated.
